rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for sympathy with someone's suffering.

example.english: I really pity him; he has had to suffer so much at such a young age.
example.traditional: 我好同情佢，咁細個就要捱咁多苦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 tung4 cing4 keoi5 gam3 sai3 go3 zau6 jiu3 ngaai4 gam3 do1 fu2

rows.note: Use this as a noun for a regrettable situation or outcome, as in 一個遺憾.

example.english: Not winning the championship was truly a pity.
example.traditional: 未能奪冠，實在係一個遺憾。
example.jyutping: mei6 nang4 dyut6 gun1 sat6 zoi6 hai6 jat1 go3 wai4 ham6
